data.description: Objects you wear and carry slip from your grasp and fall from your pockets, or suddenly pelt creatures that have acted in an unhelpful manner toward you. It takes you a standard action to retrieve a stored item, and whenever you drop or lose hold of an item, it lands 10 feet away in a random direction. You take a -%1 penalty on saving throws and to your CMD against attacks and effects that would disarm you or steal from you.|CorruptionUnrestrainedBonus
